units: <cite ref="Shabbat 50b:16">Sabb. 50ᵇ</cite> <he>דָּצָהּ שלפה וכ׳</he> if he stuck it in, pulled it out &c.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 156b:4">Ib. 156ᵇ</cite> <he>דָּצְתָהּ בגודא</he> (Ms. O. <he>דעיצתא בביזעא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 30) she stuck it (the brooch) into the wall.
<cite ref="Chullin 93b:8">Ḥull. 93ᵇ</cite> <he>אי דָץ ביה מידי</he> if he stuck something into the nostrils (so as to keep them open).

<cite ref="Sukkah 37b:2">Succ. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>לא לֵדוּץ וכ׳</he> one must not squeeze the palm branch between the myrtle and willow (after they have been tied together). [<cite ref="Bava Batra 74a">B. Bath. 74ᵃ</cite> <he>דצייה</he> Ar., v. <cite ref="D00947"><he>דְּעַץ</he></cite>.]
